extracted.name: Tomato Mushroom Soup
extracted.description: This tomato-mushroom soup features tender sautéed mushrooms and onions in a richly flavored broth made with beef stock, tomato paste, and red wine.
instruction_lines: Heat oil and butter in a medium saucepan until hot. Add onion and garlic and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes. Add mushrooms and sauté until soft, about 5 minutes.
Pour in broth, water, and wine. Add tomato paste and season with pepper. Cook until heated through, 6 to 10 minutes.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with Parmesan and parsley.
